Title: Can't create constructed events on VEKN

Messages.Author: Charles_Bronson
Messages.Body:
Good evening.

While i'm no longer a prince, i'm returning to activity and i'll be hosting a event with two and maybe three VTES tourneaments. But I noticed something very strange about the "creat an event".

I can't creat constructed events. Only "demo", launch parties and unsanctioned events open.

Why? In the entire tourneament rules (www.vekn.net/tournament-rules) there is simply no requirement for an organizer to be a prince, or anything. I thought I would only need my VEKN ID.

Why exactly can't VEKN players organize VEKN events without being registered as a prince?

thanks
Alexandre Costa

I am death.
Paul Kersey, Death Wish

Messages.Author: Charles_Bronson
Messages.Body:
Exaclty.

But... why only princes could make sanctioned events? In my city we already have a prince. While he's probably gonna play on those events, he is not the organizer.

I found it's strange to be asking permissions to host a tourneament. I also found strange that only one player in a city can host or "authorize" events.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
It is how the VEKN works.

www.vekn.net/how-to-run-a-v-tes-tournament

If you have already a prince, you can ask him to create the calendar entry, and then organize yourself the tournament.

And to be honest, I believe the title thing is a bit old fashioned. I know that exists because of the relation with the World of Darkness setting. But some people takes it too seriously. Man, I really don't know the exact way that people's' minds works.

I can only elaborate hypothesis:

May be the thing with the word "Prince" is some kind of fetish to them. Could be that they believe to be from royalty (something like a member of VTES' royal family). Or could be related to a inability to separate reality from fiction. As if they really believe to be some sort of Methuselah on a secret and eternal war. And see the title as a proof of his status in Vampire's society.
But I do know that some people (more that could be considered inoffensive), fight to the teeth for a Prince title. And use all means available to deny others (that they believe unworthy) of achieving that. Things could get even worse when such people get titles that strapolates a local sphere of influence.

So we can hope that adopting a more mundane vocabulary, that such people can see the reality more clearly.

If there is any psychologist in VTES' community, may be that he could understand better such comportamental manifestations.
